fp_rules.R1: check does not fire on the reference graph -> EXTRACTOR
fp_rules.R2: structural check still fires on the reference graph -> CHECKER
fp_rules.R3a: policy check still fires, no human node in reference -> POLICY_SPEC
fp_rules.R3b: policy check still fires but reference has a human node -> CHECKER
fp_rules.Ga: GT triage marked the reference graph wrong here -> REFERENCE_ERROR
fp_rules.Gb: reference `human` node is non-discharging (placebo audit) -> REFERENCE_ERROR

fn_rules.F1: no sensitive tool declared in the mined graph -> EXTRACTOR
fn_rules.F2: sensitive tool declared, non-discharging gate accepted -> CHECKER
fn_rules.F3: sensitive tool declared, no gate excuse -> POLICY_SPEC
fn_rules.G1: risk-aware check fires on the reference graph -> DETECTED
fn_rules.G2: effect absent even from the reference graph -> ABSTRACTION
fn_rules.G3/G4: reference graph shows the effect, check still clears -> CHECKER
